hostRequirement: Local Gentoo Linux graphical session with KWin/Xwayland and Avalonia DBus file portal

corrupt.expectedOutcome: Rejected; previous valid session remains open

actions: Start the actual Avalonia process empty, verify its process-owned window, and capture the window.
Use Ctrl+O and the real Avalonia IStorageProvider portal to select the shared 1280x720 PNG; assert visible frame, filename/hash, dimensions, 25 fps, timestamp 0/-1.
Use actual Next and Previous controls and verify timestamp changes without another presentation bitmap allocation.
Cancel a second real picker and verify active hash, timestamp, state, and copy count remain unchanged.
Select the corrupt PNG in the real picker while an image is open; assert rejection, visible old image, retained path/hash/frame and error.
Close PNG with Ctrl+W; open the authored 640x480 BMP via the real picker in the same process; verify metadata.
Use Next and Previous in the BMP session, close with Ctrl+W, reopen PNG via the real picker, verify fresh timestamp 0/-1, then exit cleanly.

Run native-player-viewport-gestures-v1 separately for actual mouse-wheel zoom, anchor preservation, drag-pan, Fit, resize, opening a new PNG after gestures (which must reset viewport), and rendered RGB/alpha samples.
screenshots: Process-owned application screenshots with synthetic fixtures are retained under docs/evidence/native-player-gui-interactions-v1; local logs/reports remain in the output directory. The Wayland portal dialog itself is NOT_CAPTURED.
limitations: Native KDE portal dialog surface is Wayland-owned and cannot be captured by the Xwayland window capture path without stealing activation; picker screenshot status is NOT_CAPTURED.
This validates the local Gentoo/KWin/Xwayland host only; Windows GUI is NOT_RUN.
Rendered screenshot samples do not replace exact decoded pixel assertions or cross-renderer screenshot parity.
No hosted GitHub Actions workflow is run for this local-only scenario.
